rules.name: Hardcoded credential
rules.description: A credential is committed to the repository in config or source.

rules.name: Credential accepted as tool input
rules.description: A tool takes a secret as a parameter, routing it through the LLM context window.

rules.name: Capability exceeds declared scope
rules.description: Code exercises a capability the manifest never declared a scope for.

rules.name: No scopes declared
rules.description: A manifest exposes tools without declaring any authorization scopes.

rules.name: Unconstrained input reaches a dangerous sink
rules.description: A free-form tool parameter flows into a handler that executes code or shells out.

rules.name: Open tool input schema
rules.description: A tool's input schema permits additional, unvalidated properties.

rules.name: Risky parameter without validation
rules.description: A tool parameter with a dangerous name has no enum, pattern, or format constraint.

rules.name: Tool declared without an input schema
rules.description: A tool exposes parameters to the model with no schema at all.

rules.name: Dependency from a non-registry source
rules.description: A package is installed from a git ref, URL, or path rather than an immutable release.

rules.name: Floating dependencies with no lockfile
rules.description: Versions are unpinned and nothing records what was resolved, so installs can differ.

rules.name: Code executes at install time
rules.description: An npm lifecycle script runs before anyone has reviewed the package.

rules.name: Tool input reaches a shell
rules.description: A model-controlled parameter flows into a command interpreter.

rules.name: Tool input reaches a dynamic evaluator
rules.description: A model-controlled parameter flows into eval/exec/Function.

rules.name: Tool input reaches a filesystem path
rules.description: A model-controlled parameter is used as a path with no confinement to a root.

rules.name: Tool description carries instructions for the model
rules.description: A tool's description instructs the model rather than describing the tool.

rules.name: Hidden characters in tool metadata
rules.description: A tool description contains invisible or direction-overriding characters.

rules.name: Remote content returned to the model unsanitized
rules.description: A tool fetches network content and hands it straight back to the model.

rules.name: Network-exposed server without authentication
rules.description: An HTTP/SSE MCP server declares no authentication.

rules.name: Wildcard CORS origin
rules.description: The server accepts cross-origin requests from any website.

rules.name: Consequential actions are never logged
rules.description: The server executes commands or writes files and calls no logging framework at all.

rules.name: Exception swallowed silently
rules.description: An error is caught and discarded in a file that executes commands or writes files.

rules.name: Multiple server instantiations
rules.description: More than one MCP server is constructed in this codebase.

rules.name: Undeclared listening port
rules.description: Code binds a port that no manifest declares.

rules.name: Environment returned to the model
rules.description: A tool hands environment variables back to the model, where the secrets live.

rules.name: Credential file within reach of a tool
rules.description: Code touches a path holding private keys, cloud credentials, or system accounts.

rules.name: Tool operates on a filesystem root
rules.description: A file operation is rooted at `/`, a home directory, or a drive root.

rules.name: Variable data interpolated into the system prompt
rules.description: A system message is built with an f-string, .format() or concatenation.

rules.name: Secret interpolated into a prompt
rules.description: An environment variable, key or password is formatted into text sent to the model.

rules.name: Model or dataset code executed from a remote repository
rules.description: `trust_remote_code=True` runs Python shipped inside the model repository.

rules.name: Model weights loaded through pickle
rules.description: `torch.load` / `joblib.load` without `weights_only=True` can execute code.

rules.name: Model downloaded without a pinned revision
rules.description: `from_pretrained` / `hf_hub_download` with no `revision=` follows a moving branch.

rules.name: Model output reaches a dangerous sink unvalidated
rules.description: LLM output is passed to eval/exec, a shell, raw HTML or a SQL string.

rules.name: Agent granted unrestricted code, shell or file capability
rules.description: An agent is wired to a shell/REPL tool or an `allow_dangerous_*` switch.

rules.name: Credential embedded in a system prompt
rules.description: A system prompt contains a key, password or token value.

rules.name: Model call with no output-token cap
rules.description: A completion request sets no `max_tokens` (or equivalent) limit.

rules.name: Request-derived value used as a file path
rules.description: A request parameter reaches a file open/send call (path traversal).

rules.name: CORS allows every origin together with credentials
rules.description: A wildcard origin is combined with credentialed requests.

rules.name: CSRF protection disabled
rules.description: A view or the whole app opts out of CSRF checks.

rules.name: Broken hash algorithm (MD5 / SHA-1)
rules.description: MD5 or SHA-1 is used; both are collision-broken and far too fast for passwords.

rules.name: TLS certificate verification disabled
rules.description: Certificate or hostname checking is turned off for an outbound connection.

rules.name: Weak or deprecated cipher
rules.description: ECB mode, DES/3DES, RC4 or the deprecated `createCipher` is used.

rules.name: Non-cryptographic random for a security value
rules.description: `random` / `Math.random` generates something named like a token, key or nonce.

rules.name: SQL built by string formatting
rules.description: A query is assembled with f-strings, %, .format() or concatenation.

rules.name: OS command built from variable data
rules.description: A shell command is assembled at runtime or run with shell=True.

rules.name: eval/exec on a non-literal
rules.description: `eval`, `exec` or `new Function` runs a runtime-built string as code.

rules.name: Unescaped output sink (XSS / template injection)
rules.description: Variable data is written as raw HTML or into a template string.

rules.name: Debug mode enabled
rules.description: The framework's debugger / debug pages are switched on in code.

rules.name: Insecure framework setting
rules.description: Wildcard allowed hosts, insecure cookie flags, or XML external entities enabled.

rules.name: JWT verification weakened or disabled
rules.description: Signature, expiry or audience checks are turned off, or the `none` algorithm is allowed.

rules.name: Hard-coded application secret or password
rules.description: A SECRET_KEY, JWT secret or password is a string literal in source.

risks.name: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures

rules.name: Unsafe deserialization
rules.description: pickle/marshal/yaml.load or a similar deserializer is applied to data.

rules.name: Remote script piped straight to a shell
rules.description: `curl ... | sh` runs unverified code fetched at execution time.

risks.name: A09 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

rules.name: Sensitive value written to the log
rules.description: A password, token or key is passed to a logging or print call.

rules.name: Exception silently swallowed
rules.description: A broad `except: pass` / empty `catch {}` hides failures, including attacks.

rules.name: Outbound request to a request-supplied URL
rules.description: An HTTP client is called with a URL taken from the incoming request (SSRF).
